The '''DL-44 XT''' was an enhanced version of [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries's]] [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]]. It was distinguished from other DL-44 models by the metals used in its construction.
